id.description: The self-referencing identifier to this object.

spec.description: The specification, parameters, and type of the activity.

settings.description: The configuration settings for the activity.

questions.description: Please answer based on when you received the notification for this survey.

schedule.description: The notification schedule for the activity.

start.description: The UNIX Epoch date-time representation: number of milliseconds since 1/1/1970 12:00 AM.

end.description: The UNIX Epoch date-time representation: number of milliseconds since 1/1/1970 12:00 AM.

start_date.description: The date after which this schedule should begin firing.

time.description: For certain `repeat_interval` types, specify the hour and minute of the day to fire.

repeat_interval.description: If set to `hourly`, `every3h`, `every6h`, or `every12h`, only the `time` parameter's minute field is used. If set to anything other than `custom` or `none`, the `time` parameter's hour and minute field are both used. The `biweekly` option refers to Tue/Thurs and `triweekly` option refers to Mon/Wed/Fri. The `bimonthly` option refers to twice a month. The `custom` option refers to only using the `custom_times` array, and the `none` option means to only trigger the schedule once.

items.description: A specific date-time to fire at.

custom_times.description: For `custom` schedules, specify a list of all specific date-times to fire at.

settings.description: The configuration settings for the sensor.

ActivityEvent.description: An event generated by the participant interacting with an `Activity`.

timestamp.description: The UNIX Epoch date-time representation of when this event was recorded: number of milliseconds since 1/1/1970 12:00 AM.

duration.description: The duration this event lasted before recording ended.

activity.description: The activity that produced this activity event.

static_data.description: The summary information for the activity event as determined by the activity that created this activity event.

temporal_slices.description: The specific interaction details of the activity event.

items.description: A specific sub-detail of a `ActivityEvent` that contains specific  interaction information that comprises the parent `ActivityEvent`.

item.description: The item that was interacted with; for example, in a Jewels game, the  corresponding alphabet, or in a survey, the question index.

value.description: The value of the item that was interacted with; in most games,  this field is  `null`, but in a survey, this field is the question  choice index.

type.description: The type of interaction that for this detail; for example, in  a Jewels game,  `none` if the tapped jewel was  incorrect, or `correct` if it was correct, or in  a  survey, this field will be `null`.

duration.description: The time difference from the previous detail or the  start of the parent result.

level.description: The level of activity for this detail; for example, in  games with multiple  levels, this field might be `2` or  `4`, but for surveys and other games this field  will be `null`.

SensorEvent.description: An event generated by a participant interacting with the LAMP app.

timestamp.description: The UNIX Epoch date-time representation of when this event was recorded: number of milliseconds since 1/1/1970 12:00 AM.

sensor.description: The type of the sensor event.

data.description: The item information recorded within the sensor event.
